videos.description: Dev Deepawali ("the Diwali of the Gods" or "Festival of Lights of the Gods") is the festival of Kartik Poornima celebrated in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. It falls on the full moon of the Hindu month of Kartik (November - December) and takes place fifteen days after Diwali. The steps of all the ghats on the riverfront of the Ganges River, are lit with more than a million earthen lamps (diyas) in honour of Mother goddess Ganga.
